title: Real classroom language arts: All Summer in a Day and Venus close reading
learning_objective: Students recall and discuss All Summer in a Day, infer character motivations and author choices, then close-read an informational text about Venus using annotation and text-dependent questions.
common_misconceptions: Stopping at plot recall instead of explaining motivation or authorial purpose.
Confusing central idea/theme with isolated factual details.
Answering text-dependent questions from opinion rather than evidence in the text.
Treating nonfiction identification as only topic-based rather than using textual features and source/date evidence.
